description: Decisive test of E037's mechanism: a 32 px adaptation cliff, or a linear freeze dose? On the E049 tip, move only the group-1 freeze start from 75% to 71% of steps, just after the 28→32 px switch at 70% (about step 168 of 237). Group 1 then sees about 2 steps at 32 px before its LR reaches 0. Anneal the group-1 LR from its peak to 0 by 71% instead of 75%. The group-2 freeze, whitening detach, step count, resolution, LR and Lookahead are unchanged. The truncated 32 px variant exists, so there are no new shapes; error_on_recompile stays on. Judge on seeds 13–32 against a same-build E049 baseline, plus seeds 0–2. The result also sets the prior for the intermittent-stem idea.
